name: Remote Work (Digital Nomad) Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Remote employee or shareholder of a company registered outside Moldova, with proof of remote-work income history, health insurance, and accommodation in Moldova. Local employment or freelancing for Moldovan entities is explicitly prohibited.

sources.title: Fragomen (immigration law firm) -- Moldova remote work visa introduced, effective 20 September 2025: eligibility, 2-year renewable duration, EUR 80-100 fee, 30-45 day processing via Bureau of Migration and Asylum, local work/freelancing prohibited
